__comments__: This file stores the default occupancy-derived (stuff-style) Occ3D raw-id -> Polygon OCC target-id mapping.
Because JSON does not support true comments, explanatory metadata is stored under __* keys.
The converter only reads numeric keys such as '1', '4', '11'.
Ignored raw ids are configured separately in the data-prep script, currently: 0, 12, 17.
Dynamic/thing classes such as car, truck, bicycle, pedestrian, traffic_cone, and barrier are intentionally omitted here because they are generated from bbox footprints in the hybrid GT pipeline.
